PZZ700-222145-
107 AM PST Sun Nov 22 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 AM, a 1024 mb high was situated over southwestern Colorado, 
a 1020 mb high was over Mono Lake, and a 995 mb low was over the
Pacific Ocean, approximately 500 nautical miles west of Seattle, 
WA. Flow will oscillate between onshore in the afternoons and 
weakly offshore for the nights and mornings through Tuesday. 
Onshore flow strengthens Tuesday into Wednesday, with gusts near 
20-25 knots in the outer waters by Wednesday afternoon. Seas look 
to increase to 8-12 feet in the outer waters late Wednesday into 
Thursday with an approaching swell. Seas will begin to wane on 
Friday and into the following weekend.
